transactions.desc: Washington demoted Palmquist to Triple-A Rochester on Saturday.
Boston optioned Burgos to Triple-A Worcester after Saturday's matchup with the Athletics, Christopher Smith of MassLive.com reports.
The Rockies reinstated Castano (pectoral) from the injured list Saturday and optioned him to Triple-A Albuquerque.
The Cubs optioned Garrett to Triple-A Iowa on Saturday, Vinnie Duber of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
The Cubs reinstated Holmes (fibula) from the 60-day injured list ahead of his start Saturday against the Royals, Vinnie Duber of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
The Mets optioned Wagaman to Triple-A Syracuse on Saturday.
The Cardinals designated Velazquez for assignment Saturday.
The Rangers optioned Peoples to Triple-A Round Rock on Saturday.
The Rangers reinstated Gore from the paternity list Saturday.
The Brewers selected Richardson's contract from Triple-A Nashville on Saturday.
The Brewers designated Wilson for assignment Saturday.
The White Sox selected Smith's contract from Triple-A Charlotte on Saturday.
The White Sox recalled McDougal from Triple-A Charlotte on Saturday.
The White Sox designated Gonzalez for assignment Saturday.
The White Sox optioned Schultz to Triple-A Charlotte on Saturday.
The White Sox optioned Sandlin to Triple-A Charlotte on Saturday.
The Reds optioned Petty to Triple-A Louisville on Saturday.
The Athletics optioned Juenger to Triple-A Las Vegas on Saturday.
The Athletics recalled Tur from Triple-A Las Vegas on Saturday.
The Tigers optioned Hanifee to Triple-A Toledo on Friday.
The Tigers reinstated Jobe (elbow) from the injured list Friday.
The Blue Jays optioned Lee to Triple-A Buffalo on Friday.
The Giants selected Harris' contract from Triple-A Sacramento on Friday.
The Giants optioned Beck to Triple-A Sacramento on Friday.
The Rays recalled Williams from Triple-A Durham on Friday.
The Astros recalled Meyers from Triple-A Sugar Land on Friday, Chandler Rome of The Athletic reports.
The Diamondbacks recalled Strowd from Triple-A Reno on Friday.
The Diamondbacks optioned Drake to Triple-A Reno on Friday.
The Mariners recalled Davila from Triple-A Tacoma on Friday.
The Twins selected Culpepper's contract from Triple-A St. Paul on Friday.
